title: A New Dinosaur Was Just Discovered. In a Museum Drawer

scenes.text: A new dinosaur was just discovered. In a museum drawer.
A fossil hunter found a chunk of skull on England's Isle of Wight. London's museum filed it away in 1924.
A century later, scientists scanned it and found a new species: a tiger-sized predator with 20 centimeter claws.
Its name means unconquered female warrior. 120 million years old, and the first of its kind in Europe.
The lead scientist says it would definitely have chased us. We're the right size for prey.
And it waited a hundred years in a drawer, for someone to look.

description:
A new dinosaur species was just discovered, in a museum drawer.
Invictibellatrix amberina, described in Royal Society Open Science in October 2026 by a team led by University College London, is a tiger-sized megaraptoran about 3 to 4 metres long with claws estimated at 10 to 20 centimetres. Its skull fragment, found on the Isle of Wight, had sat in London's Natural History Museum since 1924.
What else do you think is hiding in museum drawers?

first_comment: Bonus: the amber in the same rocks gave it its species name, amberina. If you could open one museum drawer, which museum would you pick?
